stories.headline: 8 orangutans saved from Borneo's fires are back in the wild
stories.summary: Three mother-and-baby pairs and two teen males, rescued from burning plantations, were moved to the 23,000-hectare Batu Nyambu Protected Forest. Rescuers have saved 46 orangutans from fires since August.
stories.why: Every one counts: about 104,000 orangutans are left, down from 230,000 a century ago.

stories.headline: A Year 7 pupil spent her pocket money on a hurt stranger
stories.summary: When an elderly cyclist fell, Hannah Annakin stayed by his side until help came. Learning he hadn't eaten, she bought him food with her own pocket money. A paramedic asked her school to honour her.
stories.why: Small kindness, big difference: the paramedic called it a powerful reminder.

stories.headline: A selfie with a giant waterlily revealed a new species
stories.summary: A US plant grower posted a photo of himself beside a giant waterlily in Colombia. A Kew botanist spotted it was unusual, and an expedition found seven plants: Victoria colombiana.
stories.why: Even giant plants can hide in plain sight, and now this one can be protected.

stories.headline: Norway's ice has given up 5,000+ ancient artefacts
stories.summary: In 20 years at 73 sites, the Secrets of the Ice team has found bows, arrows, shoes and clothing. This year's finds include a slate arrowhead between 5,000 and 6,000 years old.
stories.why: Lost hunting gear shows how ancient people crossed Norway's high mountains.

fun_fact: Giant Victoria waterlily pads can grow more than 3 m across.
